title: Capable Teacher, Myopic Scorer: Reward-Free Teacher Repair for Agentic On-Policy Distillation
title_zh: 能力强的教师，短视的打分器：面向智能体在线策略蒸馏的无奖励教师修复

paragraphs.en: Agentic on-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student agent on its own trajectories while a teacher scores every token. A natural explanation of where it goes wrong is compounding error: the student’s mistakes carry its trajectories beyond the region where the teacher is reliable, so recent methods keep training inside that region, through episode-length curricula, teacher-guided turns, prefix replay, or teacher intervention where the two disagree. We show this explanation is incomplete. From the states where the student departs most from the teacher, the teacher’s own takeovers still finish the task, yet the student trained on its token scores keeps running out of turns. We attribute this to the myopia of next-token scoring. The teacher rates each token without seeing where the episode ends, so its scores let through the safe, delaying moves that outcome-based RL would punish with zero reward, a penalty agentic OPD lacks. We call this difference between what the teacher does and what it scores the rollout–scorer gap . We propose Rollout-to-Scorer Distillation (R2S), which repairs the scorer before distillation by mining high-disagreement states from the untrained student, running teacher takeovers from them, keeping the states where enough takeovers pass a reward-free check such as consensus or an LLM judge, and fine-tuning the teacher to give its takeover-informed scores on every assistant token from the divergence turn onward, without the takeover in context. The repaired teacher is frozen as the sole scorer for standard OPD, requiring no task reward during repair or training. Across three environments, two teachers and four students, R2S outperforms three state-of-the-art agentic-OPD methods in all twelve teacher–student–environment cells, by 12.8 12.8 success points on average over the best of them in each cell. Project page: https://tree-shu-zhao.github.io/r2s/ .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式在线策略蒸馏（OPD）通过让学生智能体基于自身轨迹进行训练，同时由教师智能体对每个词元进行评分。 对其失效原因的一种自然解释是错误累积：学生的错误会使其轨迹超出教师智能体可靠作用的区域，因此近期方法通过限制单轮长度、采用教师引导步骤、前缀重播或当两者意见不一致时引入教师干预，来确保训练始终在该区域内进行。 我们证明这一解释并不完整。 在学生与教师策略偏离最显著的状态中，教师智能体亲自接管后仍能完成任务，但基于自身词元评分训练的学生智能体却会因步数耗尽而终止。 我们将此归因于“下一词元评分”机制的短视性。 教师智能体在评分时无法看到单轮任务的最终结果，因此其评分会允许那些基于结果的强化学习会因零奖励而惩罚的安全但延迟的行动，而这种惩罚正是智能体式OPD所缺乏的。 我们将教师实际行为与其评分之间的差异称为“滚动预测-评分者差距”。 我们提出“滚动预测到评分者蒸馏”（R2S）方法：该方法在蒸馏前修复评分机制，具体包括从未经训练的学生智能体中挖掘分歧度高的状态、在这些状态下运行教师接管流程、保留能通过无奖励检查（如共识或LLM判官）的状态，并对教师智能体进行微调，使其从产生分歧的步数开始，为每个助手词元提供基于接管信息的评分，而无需在上下文中实际执行接管。 修复后的教师智能体被冻结并作为标准OPD的唯一评分者，在整个修复和训练过程中均无需任务奖励。 在三个环境、两种教师和四种学生的组合中，R2S在所有十二种“教师-学生-环境”配置下均优于三种最先进的智能体式OPD方法，且在每个配置中平均比最佳方法高出12.8个成功点。 项目页面：https://tree-shu-zhao.github.io/r2s/ .

paragraphs.en: Agentic on-policy distillation (OPD) trains an agent on its own trajectories. The student acts in a live environment, and a stronger teacher scores every token it produces ( Liao et al., 2026 ) . The teacher never acts in this loop; it only scores, and its next-token distribution on the student’s histories is the whole training signal. This form of dense supervision also underlies the multi-teacher post-training pipelines of MiMo-V2-Flash and Nemotron-Cascade 2 ( Xiao et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在智能体自身的轨迹上进行训练。 学生在真实环境中执行操作，而一个能力更强的教师会对它生成的每个词元进行评分（Liao 等，2026）。 教师在此循环中从不执行操作；它仅负责评分，而其在学生历史记录上的下一个词元分布即构成了完整的训练信号。 这种密集监督形式也是 MiMo-V2-Flash 和 Nemotron-Cascade 2 的多教师后训练流程的基础（Xiao 等，2026；Yang 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: We show this explanation is incomplete. We take the states where the untrained student disagrees most with the teacher, late in its episodes, the states that compounding error should place furthest outside the teacher’s region, and let the teacher act from them. Its takeovers still finish the task. In every environment they beat the student’s own outcome from the same states, and they rescue many of the states the student went on to lose. The student has not drifted beyond what the teacher can handle. Yet the teacher’s plain scores let the student’s delay pass: only with one of its finishing takeovers in context do they mark down the student’s hedging and searching, and the student trained on the plain scores keeps running out of turns. Figure 1 illustrates this.
paragraphs.zh: 我们表明这种解释并不完整。 我们选取那些未训练的学生在后期阶段与教师意见分歧最大的状态——也就是累积错误应将其推离教师区域最远的状态——并让教师从这些状态开始行动。 它的接管操作仍然能够完成任务。 在所有环境中，它们的表现都优于学生在相同状态下取得的成果，并且挽救了许多学生最终会失败的状态。 学生并未偏离到超出教师处理能力之外的范围。 然而，教师的普通评分却让学生得以拖延：只有在结合其一次结束性接管操作的情况下，评分才会对学生的犹豫和探索行为做出负面评价，而基于普通评分训练的学生则会不断耗尽行动机会。 图1对此进行了说明。

paragraphs.en: We attribute this to the myopia of next-token scoring. Acting, the teacher writes the whole episode itself: each action is followed by its consequences and by the teacher’s own next action, and the episode runs to an outcome. Scoring, it rates each of the student’s tokens one at a time, on a history it did not write, without seeing where the episode ends. Under that uncertainty another look or another search keeps options open and is reasonable on its own, so the teacher’s scores let it pass. Outcome-based RL punishes such delay with zero reward when the episode runs out, while agentic OPD has no such penalty. We call this difference between what the teacher does and what it scores the rollout–scorer gap . This motivates informing the scores with selected teacher continuations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将此归因于“下一个词元”评分的短视性。 在执行阶段，教师会自行撰写整个回合：每个动作之后都会紧接着其后果以及教师自己的下一个动作，直到回合结束。 在评分阶段，它会逐个对学生的每个词元进行评分，依据的是它并未撰写的历史记录，且无法看到回合的终点。 在这种不确定性下，再次审视或再次搜索能够保持选项的开放性，这本身是合理的，因此教师的评分会允许这种情况发生。 基于结果的强化学习会在回合结束时因这种延迟而给予零奖励作为惩罚，而智能体导向的 OPD 则没有此类惩罚。 我们将教师所执行的行为与评分行为之间的这一差异称为“展开-评分差距”。 这促使我们通过引入教师选定的后续内容来改进评分。

paragraphs.en: Rollout-to-Scorer Distillation (R2S) repairs the scorer before distillation. First, the teacher takes over from the untrained student’s highest-disagreement states. Second, we keep the states where enough takeovers pass a reward-free check, consensus among them or an LLM judge, and pick the shortest passing one as the reference. Third, we fine-tune the teacher to give its takeover-informed scores on every assistant token from the selected divergence turn onward, without the takeover in context. The repaired teacher is frozen for standard OPD. Student training retains the ordinary OPD objective and rollout recipe, and no task reward enters repair or training. We evaluate R2S across three environments, two teachers and four students under a fixed final-checkpoint protocol. R2S outperforms three state-of-the-art agentic-OPD methods in every cell. The gain over the best of them in each cell averages + 17.0 +17.0 points from the 9B teacher and + 8.5 +8.5 from the 30B-A3B teacher.
paragraphs.zh: Rollout-to-Scorer Distillation (R2S) 在蒸馏前修复评分器。 首先，教师模型从未经训练的学生模型中分歧度最高的状态开始接管。 其次，我们保留那些经过足够多次接管并通过无奖励检查、相互共识或 LLM 判定的状态，并从中选择最短的通过状态作为参考。 第三，我们对教师模型进行微调，使其在从选定的分歧回合开始，为每个助手生成的词元提供基于接管信息的评分，但上下文不包含该接管过程。 修复后的教师模型在标准 OPD 过程中保持冻结。 学生模型的训练保留常规的 OPD 目标和 rollout 流程，且任何任务奖励都不会进入修复或训练环节。 我们在三种环境、两种教师模型和四种学生模型上，依据固定的最终检查点协议对 R2S 进行了评估。 在每一个单元格中，R2S 的表现均优于三种最先进的智能体 OPD 方法。 在每个单元格中，与最佳方法相比，其提升幅度平均为：来自 9B 教师模型的 +17.0 分，以及来自 30B-A3B 教师模型的 +8.5 分。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are: (1) The rollout–scorer gap. Section 3 shows that the teacher’s takeovers still finish from the states where the student departs most from it, while its plain scores let the student’s delay pass; only a finishing takeover in context turns them against it. paragraphs.en: On-policy distillation for agents. ReOPD identifies a prefix trap: histories closer to the student’s distribution can make the teacher’s targets less reliable, motivating a curriculum over replayed teacher prefixes ( Liao et al., 2026 ) . Our compared methods address related trajectory-level difficulties: TCOD-F2B schedules rollout depth, Guided-OPD allocates teacher-controlled turns, and FutureBridge validates teacher bridges from high-disagreement states ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . These methods retain the original scorer. R2S repairs its token scores before student training, a change that can be combined with student-side curricula.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的在线策略蒸馏。 ReOPD 发现了一种前缀陷阱：与学生的分布更接近的历史记录可能会使教师的目标变得不那么可靠，因此需要采用基于重播教师前缀的课程设计（Liao et al., 2026）。 我们比较的方法解决了相关的轨迹层面难题：TCOD-F2B 规划展开深度，Guided-OPD 分配由教师控制的回合，而 FutureBridge 则从高度不一致的状态中验证教师提供的桥接（Wang et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026a；Chen et al., 2026）。 这些方法保留了原始的评分器。 R2S 在学生训练前修复其词元分数，这一改动可以与学生侧的课程设计相结合。

paragraphs.en: Context and self-distillation. SDFT and Self-Distilled Reasoner use demonstration-conditioned self-teachers to supervise student rollouts ( Shenfeld et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026b ) . SDPO instead conditions on textual feedback or successful attempts ( Hübotter et al., 2026 ) , while OPCD internalizes experiential knowledge and system prompts through on-policy context distillation ( Ye et al., 2026 ) . CANON selects privileged solutions by consensus without gold labels ( Gkountouras et al., 2026 ) . These works establish that useful distillation signals need not come from task rewards. R2S uses teacher takeovers to repair an external scorer, then freezes it for a separate student’s OPD.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文与自蒸馏。 SDFT 和 Self-Distilled Reasoner 使用以演示为条件的自教师来监督学生模型的推理过程（Shenfeld 等，2026；Zhao 等，2026b）。 SDPO 则基于文本反馈或成功尝试进行条件设定（Hübotter 等，2026），而 OPCD 通过在线策略上下文蒸馏将经验知识与系统提示内化（Ye 等，2026）。 CANON 无需黄金标签，即可通过共识选择最优解决方案（Gkountouras 等，2026）。 这些研究表明，有用的蒸馏信号并不一定来自任务奖励。 R2S 利用教师接管来修复外部评分器，然后将其冻结用于另一个学生模型的在线策略蒸馏。

paragraphs.en: Teacher quality and repair. Li et al. (2026b) show that a higher-scoring teacher need not transfer better: compatible reasoning patterns and new capabilities matter. Kaur et al. (2026) find that privileged context can suppress self-correction and degrade thinking models. These results motivate checking what the teacher’s local signal teaches, beyond its standalone performance. Distillation Traps and Guards directly calibrates an external teacher with utility and calibration rewards ( Zhan et al., 2026 ) . R2S instead fits takeover-informed token targets without task reward and evaluates the repaired scorer through target fidelity and downstream completion. Sections A.1 and A.2 give the detailed comparisons and extended discussion.
paragraphs.zh: 教师质量与修复。Li等人（2026b）指出，得分更高的教师并不一定能够带来更好的迁移效果：兼容的推理模式和新能力同样重要。Kaur等人（2026）发现，特权上下文可能会抑制自我纠正，并降低思考模型的性能。这些结果促使我们超越教师的独立表现，进一步检验其局部信号究竟传授了哪些内容。《蒸馏陷阱与防护》通过效用和校准奖励直接对外部教师进行校准（Zhan等人，2026）。而R2S则无需任务奖励，而是基于接管信息拟合标记目标，并通过目标保真度和下游任务完成度来评估修复后的评分模型。A.1和A.2节提供了详细的比较与扩展讨论。

The student acts in the environment: at each turn t t it reads the history h t h_{t} (the task, the observations so far and its own earlier responses) and emits a response y t y_{t} ; the environment returns the next observation. In vanilla OPD the teacher does not act; it scores every token the student produces, given the same history.

paragraphs.en: Where the student trains is not the whole story. Recent methods trace what goes wrong in agentic OPD to long horizons. The student’s early mistakes compound ( Ross et al., 2011 ) and carry it into states beyond the teacher’s reach, where the teacher’s scores can no longer guide it, so the student learns the wrong thing there. TCOD-F2B, Guided-OPD and FutureBridge therefore keep training within that reach, by shortening the student’s episodes, handing turns to the teacher, or intervening where the two disagree.
paragraphs.zh: 学生接受训练的地方并非故事的全部。 近期的方法将智能体 OPD 中出现的错误归因于长期规划。 学生早期的错误会不断累积（Ross 等人，2011），并导致其进入教师无法触及的状态，在这些状态下，教师的评分无法再对其进行引导，因此学生会在那里学到错误的东西。 因此，TCOD-F2B、Guided-OPD 和 FutureBridge 通过缩短学生的回合、将行动权交给教师，或在两者意见相左时进行干预，从而将训练限制在可触及的范围内。

paragraphs.en: The explanation assumes that the states the student drifts into lie beyond what the teacher can handle. If so, the teacher acting from them should fail as well. We test this on the states the explanation points to: the turns at which the untrained student’s next-token distribution departs most from the teacher’s. From each state the teacher takes over eight times. As the success columns of Table 1 show, in every environment its takeovers finish more often than the student did from the same states. The student has not drifted beyond what the teacher can handle.
paragraphs.zh: 该解释假设学生陷入的状态超出了教师能够应对的范围。 如果是这样，那么基于这些状态采取行动的教师也应该会失败。 我们针对该解释所指出的状态进行了测试：即未受训练的学生在下一个词元分布上偏离教师分布最显著的那些转折点。 从每个状态出发，教师都会接管超过八次。 如表1中的成功列所示，在所有环境中，教师的接管都比学生从相同状态出发时的表现更为频繁地取得成功。 学生并未陷入超出教师应对能力的状态。

paragraphs.en: Outcome-based RL punishes delay with zero reward when the episode runs out of turns; plain scoring lacks this continuation signal. Acting, the teacher generates a continuation from the student’s state, observes the consequences of its actions, and reaches an outcome. Scoring, it rates the student’s tokens given the observed history, without that continuation in context. Its probabilities may encode expectations about future outcomes, but ordinary OPD supplies no explicit feedback from the realized task outcome. This distinction matters when useful information gathering and costly delay look similar locally. Another look or search keeps options open, but it spends one turn of a fixed budget, which the student trained on plain scores often uses up. Plain next-token scores carry no penalty for delay: each extra look is scored on its own, and on its own it is reasonable. Conditioning the scorer on a selected teacher continuation changes its supervision on the same student text. We call the distinction between the teacher’s demonstrated rollout competence and its token-level supervision the rollout–scorer gap .

paragraphs.en: R2S targets the rollout–scorer gap of Section 3 . The teacher’s rollouts from the student’s states carry the judgment its scores lack. paragraphs.en: Environments. ALFWorld (household tasks), WebShop (shopping) and ScienceWorld (science experiments) are scored by success (%). paragraphs.en: Baselines. Vanilla OPD minimizes Eq. 1 with the sampled estimator against the original teacher T 0 T_{0} ; R2S runs the same OPD against the repaired teacher T ϕ T_{\phi} , so vanilla OPD is its direct control. The other three are recent agentic-OPD methods, chosen because, like R2S, they train the student by distillation alone, without a task-reward RL objective such as GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . TCOD-F2B ( Wang et al., 2026 ) trains the student on shortened episodes that lengthen over training, Guided-OPD ( Li et al., 2026a ) hands part of the turns to the teacher, and FutureBridge ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , the closest prior method, trains the student on validated teacher bridges from the states where the two disagree most. Their code is public, so all three run under the same models, prompts, estimator and protocol as vanilla OPD and R2S. We leave out methods that combine distillation with reward-based RL, such as SDAR ( Lu et al., 2026 ) : their students also learn from task reward, which would confound the comparison; a repaired teacher could serve as the distillation term of such a hybrid.
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法。 原始 OPD 使用采样估计器对公式 1 进行最小化，并与原始教师 T₀ 进行比较；R2S 则使用相同的 OPD 与修复后的教师 T_φ 进行比较，因此原始 OPD 是其直接对照方法。 另外三种是近期的智能体-OPD 方法，之所以选择它们，是因为与 R2S 一样，这些方法仅通过蒸馏训练学生模型，而不涉及像 GRPO（Shao 等人，2024）这样的任务奖励强化学习目标。 TCOD-F2B（Wang 等人，2026）在缩短的回合序列上训练学生模型，且这些序列会随训练过程逐渐延长；Guided-OPD（Li 等人，2026a）将部分回合交给教师执行；而 FutureBridge（Chen 等人，2026）作为最接近的前序方法，则在两个模型分歧最大的状态上，利用验证过的教师桥接来训练学生模型。 这些方法的代码均已公开，因此三者均在与原始 OPD 和 R2S 相同的模型、提示词、估计器和协议下运行。 我们未纳入将蒸馏与基于奖励的强化学习相结合的方法，例如 SDAR（Lu 等人，2026）：其学生模型也会从任务奖励中学习，这会混淆比较结果；修复后的教师模型可以作为此类混合方法中的蒸馏项。

paragraphs.en: The teacher can be the student’s own base model. Table 3 repeats the Qwen3.5-4B cells with the 4B as its own teacher. In all three environments, the R2S student taught by the repaired 4B passes the vanilla student that the 9B teaches in Table 2 . Since the teacher and the student are the same model, the student–teacher gap that ranks states is zero, so the pipeline draws one turn per episode of the untrained student at random under the same goal cap and budget; the 4B itself runs the takeovers and the selection, so no larger model enters the pipeline. paragraphs.en: Student-side curricula. TCOD-F2B ( Wang et al., 2026 ) gradually lengthens the student’s training episodes. Guided-OPD ( Li et al., 2026a ) assigns a decreasing share of turns to the teacher, combining cross-entropy on teacher tokens with distillation on student tokens. paragraphs.en: FutureBridge and teacher continuations. FutureBridge ( Chen et al., 2026 ) is our closest experimental comparator. It continues from high-disagreement student states and validates a bridge with short student rollouts; accepted teacher text enters the student’s training buffer, alongside a curriculum over success-selected reference prefixes. Its online acceptance rule reads no task reward, although the reference pool uses success selection. R2S instead uses a selected takeover as privileged context for teacher repair: the teacher learns to reproduce its informed scores without that context and is then frozen, and the student retains ordinary OPD.

paragraphs.en: Privileged context and consensus. SDFT ( Shenfeld et al., 2026 ) and Self-Distilled Reasoner ( Zhao et al., 2026b ) train an acting model from a demonstration-conditioned self-teacher. Our consensus selection follows this principle, applied to an external teacher’s continuations from student states; the model being fitted becomes the scorer of a subsequent distillation stage.

We exclude this additional student reward signal from the experimental comparison; R2S could supply the distillation scorer of such a hybrid.

paragraphs.en: OPD at scale. MiMo-V2-Flash integrates domain-specialized teachers with dense token-level supervision ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) , and Nemotron-Cascade 2 uses multi-domain OPD between Cascade RL stages to recover capabilities from the strongest intermediate domain checkpoints ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . Our question concerns the quality of the next-token supervision a given teacher supplies on multi-turn student histories.
paragraphs.zh: 大规模 OPD。 MiMo-V2-Flash 将领域专用教师与密集的 token 级监督相结合（Xiao 等，2026），而 Nemotron-Cascade 2 则在 Cascade RL 阶段之间使用多领域 OPD，以从最强的中间领域检查点中恢复能力（Yang 等，2026）。 我们的问题涉及给定教师对多轮学生历史所提供的下一个 token 监督的质量。

paragraphs.en: Other ways to adapt a model. OPD is one of several routes from a pretrained model to a task. Fine-tuning adapts the weights on fixed data, through low-rank adapters, knowledge-anchored low-resource adaptation or prompt-based continual learning ( Zhao et al., 2026a ; Zhao et al., 2025a ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Zou et al., 2025 ) ; RL adapts them on task reward, as in ParallelSearch for search agents ( Zhao et al., 2025b ) ; in-context learning leaves the weights fixed and adapts through examples, including self-mined errors ( Zhao & Yu, 2026 ) ; and task-specific models are built for one domain ( Hao et al., 2025 ) . Agentic OPD differs from all four in its signal: a teacher’s next-token distribution on the student’s own trajectories, scored while the student acts.
paragraphs.zh: 模型适应的其他方法。 OPD 是从预训练模型到特定任务的多种路径之一。 微调通过在固定数据上调整权重来实现适应，方法包括低秩适配器、知识锚定的低资源适应或提示驱动的持续学习（Zhao et al., 2026a ; Zhao et al., 2025a ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Zou et al., 2025）；强化学习则通过任务奖励来调整权重，例如 ParallelSearch 中的搜索智能体（Zhao et al., 2025b）；上下文学习保持权重固定，并通过示例进行适应，包括自我挖掘的错误（Zhao & Yu, 2026）；而任务专用模型则是为单一领域构建的（Hao et al., 2025）。 智能体驱动的 OPD 在信号来源上与其他四种方法均有所不同：该信号来自教师模型对学生自身轨迹的下一个词元分布，并在学生执行操作时进行评分。

paragraphs.en: Privileged targets and plain scores. The frozen teacher T 0 T_{0} scores the student’s unmodified token stream through the end of the episode. In the privileged pass the selected takeover is inserted as one extra user message immediately before the student’s first turn. The message is headed “Reference walkthrough” and lists the teacher’s thinking and action for each takeover step, without the replayed prefix and without environment observations; the header presents it as a successful expert completion of the same task. Every position of the student stream shifts by one constant offset, so the two passes align position by position. The plain pass scores the same stream without the message. Both passes cache per-position top-16 (token, log-probability) lists. Every assistant position from the mined turn, inclusive, to the student’s final assistant turn receives q + q^{+} , including assistant turns without a tool call; earlier history remains causal context, and prompts and environment observations are not targets. R2S trains only on the privileged targets; the plain pass is the reference of the drop columns of Table 1 .

paragraphs.en: Loss and fine-tuning. The loss at each labeled position is the cross-entropy between the target q + q^{+} , kept on its top-16 tokens and renormalized, and the model’s full-vocabulary log-softmax. The targets are computed once from the frozen T 0 T_{0} and are not recomputed as T ϕ T_{\phi} trains. As in Eq. 3 , we average all selected assistant positions within each state, then average states. The teacher is initialized from T 0 T_{0} and fine-tuned full-parameter for one epoch at learning rate 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} , with AdamW (betas 0.9 / 0.95 0.9/0.95 , no weight decay), 10 warmup steps followed by cosine decay to 0.1 × 0.1\times , gradient clip 1.0, batches of 8 labeled states and bf16; 10% of goals form a goal-disjoint held-out split. For Qwen3.5-9B the vision tower stays frozen, so full-parameter means the text decoder. The label-SFT control of Table 5 uses the same recipe. The repaired teacher is then refrozen and scores otherwise ordinary OPD in place of T 0 T_{0} , with the sampled estimator of Eq. 4 ; the original teacher takes no part in the student’s training.

paragraphs.en: Environments. WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022 ) reports success on the 500 canonical evaluation goals and on a disjoint 256-goal pool. paragraphs.zh: 环境。 WebShop（Yao 等人，2022）报告在 500 个标准评估目标以及一个独立的 256 目标池中取得了成功。 ALFWorld（Shridhar 等人，2021）报告了在其预留游戏中，基于与 TCOD 对齐的全历史协议下，已见目标和未见目标的成功率；我们的封装器仅在成功时结束一个回合。 ScienceWorld（Wang 等人，2022）遵循 TCOD 的划分方式：17 种训练任务类型中每种类型的半数变体用于训练，从另一半中采样的 140 个变体构成已见评估集，而冻结的 1,308 项任务测试集中未见类型的头 134 行则构成未见评估集；其指标为模拟器的完成标志，而模拟器和展示给智能体的动作与对象列表均与 TCOD 的一致。

Figure 3 follows vanilla OPD, TCOD-F2B, Guided-OPD, FutureBridge and R2S from the Qwen3.5-9B teacher to the Qwen3.5-4B student under the protocol of Appendix D . Each method has three training runs per environment, started from the same untrained student and differing only in the training seed; the three R2S runs share the one repaired teacher of Table 2 , so its band reflects student training alone. Each run is evaluated every 25 updates under its own seed, update 0 being the untrained student common to all five curves. Lines are means over the three runs and bands one sample standard deviation, without interpolation or checkpoint selection; the dashed line is the teacher acting alone.
